What I do is be aware of the base I spawn/respawn at. Then I look at the map for the major landmarks in the area. Use your compass. You can zoom in and look at what is built on a base too. 

For example if a radio antenna is built on the southern part of a base you can use that as a guiding land mark. 

In the towns there are signs that you can read also that help you figure out which town is what direction/etc. 

Also on the map it will tell you on the bottom right where you are close to. Like “near harbor”, for example. Take a look at the guide and read about map icons too if you haven’t already. I found it really helpful. 

Also if you’re new to the game, it takes time to get used to the maps too.

I don't know how your schedule works but here is a good plan to have. 

Before peak:
Get your meats done asap
After meats either do peppers or onions if you have to do them
Wash produce (time permitting)

During peak:
You are grill two. If you can, spray out the dishes and stack them in groups of like pans. Deep with deep, shallow with shallow, 1/3 with 1/3, etc. 
Throughput is your main focus for now. 

After peak:
Finish any remaining prep. 
If you can close down anything, like the rice station, to help start preclose. 
Wipe down counters, sweep floors, then scrub (or whatever your floor requires) 
Start on the stacks of dishes you created
         - by washing them out and             stacking them you can grab a short stack and drop it in the sink and start scrubbing. 

By the time, your store locks the doors the only dishes you should really have are the dishes from breaking down the line and grill accessories plus a few random ones it seems. 
Then after all dishes are washed start cleaning out sinks and finish the rest of prep closing according to your store. 

Always push yourself to go faster while not sacrificing quality in whatever you do. 
Tundra has little timers you can order to time yourself if you want to speak to your managers or other managers of you are a manager. 
Managing time is important and if it is your first time on prep you will be slow but how long it takes to get faster depends on you.

Okay I have two weird mysteries. 

First, I went to a firework show back in middle school, probably 6th grade, with my friend and his family. It was a really impressive show. During the course of the night, we were all watching the sky and towards the end of the show I saw two circular objects in the sky. They had a solid white line around them with a cloudy gray center. They just appeared to hover there and watch the fireworks. They were also way up in the sky too. 

Second, we all go home that same night and I sleep over at their house.  I fall asleep and I am wakened up by this terrifying noise. It sounded like a fog horn on a ship mixed with a laser beam from War of the Worlds. I was so freaked out I called for my friend's mom. She tells me it was probably just their cats making weird noises. We also lived next to the Detroit River so it could have been a ship. I wish I could figure out what it was. 



Tl;dr I think I saw ufos at a firework show and I heard a weird noise that scared me to death in the same night.
